payload.text: THE DAY AFTER 3.2.5, LATE EVENING (vc, 2026-10-23, the localfold before the second bounce). The line is drawn and 3.2.6 is a patch (decision 70); every open issue carries its spec in its record. (1) CLOSED today: 0622, 0626, 0611, 0628, 0627 (37ba1be83 / 46b16553f), 0624 (6a95721f2 / 2b486174f), 0614 (landed 8f1fda69b, closed c59e80779), 0623 (fixed 6bd64b1c8, shots refreshed f2ece5503, closed b5e0fd2b3). LANDED: the preflight gate at f40df8f72 (dc, on vc's ruling under the pen: a push to upstream needs a green kovacs summary covering each pushed commit; a green at S covers P through board-only commits and the driver's own stamp known by its diff; `bin/devbin build release` asks `bin/int prepush --preflight-covers HEAD` and stops before it stamps; the order is in the tree at bin/.devbin/preflight-linux.sh and copies its summary to ~/.local/share/intent/preflight/<sha>.summary; releasing.md step 2 gained the sub-bullet). The installed pair is c59e80779 (vc's build all at 18:41Z, intentd restarted). FILED: 0631, 0632 (behind the line), 0633 (ic, banked, read), 0634 (hv's ruling); 0527 annotated. OPEN: 0616, 0617, 0618, 0629, 0630, 0631, 0632, 0633, 0634. (2) 0630: ruling (B) proven unsound by its own arm (cc's run, END 18:19Z); ruling (S) taken 18:38Z on cc's shape note 2 (blob e3bbea3c812e): the scan never writes a generated view's row (resync carries view rows forward), record_landed records every view its set carried, doctor's arm is bytes-equal-to-the-row read before and after; cc builds it as refs/bank/cc/0630/fix-s, no cargo until the stacked run. (3) THE TEMPLATES LANDING: templates-c's Rust arms went red on migrated_guards_still_refuse (an unreadable config made the gate refuse every commit); ruling (b) 18:53Z: `intent guards` and `intent lang declared` answer exit 4 when the config cannot be read, the gate fails open saying so and refuses on 1; the fixture gets a valid config; re-banked as templates-d with fmt, clippy, doc and the selected arms rerun in the cargo slot (in flight at the fold). (4) THE HOST: devbin-dc's 0206 bats pass runs (its GNU half at the fold); at its END Utilz 2.14.2 takes the host for utilz-dc's dry run and hv's Utilz cut (hv's word to utilz-vc), Devbin holding, Intent starting nothing heavy from Utilz's GO to its cut END, both relayed by vc. hv chose in vc's TUI (answer before vc's 18:30Z clock read), "Start now, beside the Mac's runs": the first kovacs preflight runs on 9eb9790db with the banked order (sha256 d3000b60), its result by hv's paste. (5) AFTER THE BOUNCE, in order, each on vc's GO: cc's templates shell half whole, the landing, `intent claude skills sync`, 0616, 0617 and 0618 closed, kovacs-sysadm told the gate needs the 3.2.6 pair; the stacked run (0630 (S) and 0633, composed in both orders, compared by write-tree), landings and closes; vc's build all #2 on the final HEAD, intentd restarted; dc's known-defects re-drive (refs/bank/dc/kd326/drive.sh) and ic's reference set (regen-reference.sh; both halves at that HEAD against v3.2.5; a second shots run) committed before step 3; cc's CHANGELOG audit of every issue closed since v3.2.5 against its landing commit; vc runs reference_current_check.sh, the globalfold of intent/wip.md (v3.21), the board render chain, then READY to hv. hv's hand then: the kovacs preflight on that tip with the in-tree order's two lines (an hour), `intent daemon stop`, `bin/devbin build release v3.2.6` (--dry-run first), `bin/int macos prepare`, `bin/int macos publish`, `bin/int brew smoke --reinstall` then `brew unlink intent && brew pin intent && intent daemon restart`, the app swap from target/dist, the site's db/release.json; vc's recommendation to hv (18:43Z): land everything tonight, start the final preflight last thing, cut tomorrow morning on its green. (6) 0629 next session (dc); dc's guards pass remainder after the cut; D55 in Devbin (WP-08 at 5059a26e and devbin-vc's landing suite after Utilz, on vc's relay); ST0085 for hv's read; the five .py removals and 0634 in hv's hand. No push, no release.
